title: Nourishing Syrian Napa Cabbage Pilaf
description: A yeasty and gooey Syrian dish featuring napa cabbage, perfect for meal prep, this raw-friendly pilaf is a nutritious and delicious option for any time of day. The tadka adds a burst of flavor to this hearty dish.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the shredded napa cabbage and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the ground cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper.
Add the spice mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked brown rice to the pan and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, proof the active dry yeast by mixing it with 1 tablespoon of warm water.
Add the yeast mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the pilaf to a serving dish and serve hot.
